signals.title: USD/JPY — Geopolitical De-escalation + Yield Advantage
signals.text: The US-Iran pause in strikes and fruitful Oman talks provide a risk-on tailwind for the dollar toward the 164.0 level as safe-haven demand recedes. USD/JPY maintains a +266bp OIS carry advantage and remains above all major SMAs (20, 50, 200), while JPY COT net short -114k positions leave the pair vulnerable only to a sharp risk-off reversal. The next BoJ meeting (mkt: 100% hold priced) on 31 Jul is the catalyst for determining if the current yield gap begins to compress.

signals.title: GBP/USD — G10 Bilateral Theme + Monetary Divergence
signals.text: The 1.005% G10 performance spread between leader USD and laggard GBP pressures the pair toward Friday's 1.3347 close as UK yields lose momentum. GBP COT net long +33.8k (66% long) creates an unwind risk if the pair sustains its position below the 200-day SMA (1.3399). The BoE meeting on 30 Jul is the catalyst for verifying if the hold bias can withstand the recent underperformance.

signals.title: EUR/USD — ESI Disappointment + Crowded Shorts
signals.text: The negative ESI of -14.7 highlights sustained Eurozone data misses, keeping the pair heavy below the SMA20 (1.1419) despite a potential relief bounce on geopolitical easing. EUR COT net short -80.6k (32% long) suggests bearish sentiment is heavily priced, but the 146bp OIS carry disadvantage vs USD limits recovery potential. The next ECB meeting (mkt: 61% hike priced) on 10 Sep determines if the hiking cycle can persist against deteriorating data.

signals.title: USD/CAD — COT Positioning vs Crude Correlation Break
signals.text: CAD COT net short -99.8k (18.8% long) represents extreme bearish crowding, yet the -1.63σ correlation break with WTI oil prevents a clean rally above 1.4100. While the 137bp OIS carry advantage favors the dollar, the extreme retail short bias (69%) suggests a contrarian risk of CAD strength if oil supply fears re-emerge. The next BoC meeting (mkt: 100% hold priced) on 9 Sep is the catalyst for resolving the current neutral data trend.

signals.title: AUD/USD — Carry Advantage + Retail Extreme
signals.text: AUD/USD remains supported by a +71bp OIS carry advantage and positive ESI (+4.3), though the 0.7000 handle serves as psychological resistance. Extreme retail positioning in AUD crosses, including 96% short in AUD/CHF, indicates a high risk of a short-squeeze in Sydney trade. The next RBA meeting (mkt: 21% hike priced) on 11 Aug provides the catalyst to confirm the current hike bias.
